text: Overhead view of a white plastic panel or plate, lying flat, with a grid of small drilled holes across its surface (some holes appear dark/open, others lighter). Four square white blocks are mounted on it. Top-left block has a shallow circular recess, appearing closed/covered. Top-right block has an open circular bore through it. Middle block (lower centre) also has an open circular bore. The lower-left block holds a dark teal/grey and pale blue circular fitting or filter unit, with a thin translucent tube looping up and to the left. No liquids are visible. At the bottom edge, a metal fitting and a small orange item project past the panel. Background right shows dark grey tiled flooring.
